details.question: 我想一个人安静地待一会儿，看看书放空，不希望周围太吵。

evidence.text: 这家店正是 Art Museum/Fairmount 区域所需要的。它小巧、古朴，价格真的很不错。员工也非常友好。他们会在开门前让你进去，也会在关门后让你多待一会儿。后面也有座位，包括一张长沙发和几把沙发椅。所以不要被窗外看到的前面几张桌子骗了。员工还在增加更多艺术品和装饰，所以这里只会越来越好。如果你想找一个新的地方安静地消磨一个下午，喝很棒的咖啡，又离 Fairmount Ave 繁忙的人流足够远，那就来这里。
evidence.originalText:
This place is exactly what we need in the Art Museum/Fairmount area. It's small, quaint, really well priced. The staff are extremely friendly too. They'll let you in even before they open and they'll let you stay after they close.

There's also seating in the back, including a couch and some sofa chairs. So don't be deceived when you look through the window and see just a few tables in front. The staff is also adding more artwork and decor, so it's only getting better. If you're looking for a new spot to chill for an afternoon that's quiet, serves great coffee, and far enough away from the busy foot traffic of fairmount ave, come here.

evidence.text: 这个地方很可爱，但是小而且吵。如果你坐在前面，咖啡机声音很大。我相信后面会安静一些。我点了一杯冰拿铁，饮品相当不错。不过服务一般——我问了一个关于饮品菜单的问题，却感觉自己像是在打扰咖啡师。
evidence.originalText: The place is cute, but small and noisy. The coffee machines are loud if you sit in the front. I'm sure it's more quiet in the back. I had an iced latte. The drink was pretty good. The service was mediocre though--I felt like I was intruding the barista for asking a question about their drink menu.

evidence.text: 我们第一次来。只买了些意式烟肉——但，很漂亮！和妈妈聊了一会儿，看着她做香肠！我们一定会再来的！
evidence.originalText: Our first time in. We only bought some Pancetta - but, it's beautiful! Spent some time chatting with Mom while we watched her make sausages! We'll definitely be back!
evidence.contentZh: 我们第一次来。只买了些意式烟肉——但，很漂亮！和妈妈聊了一会儿，看着她做香肠！我们一定会再来的！

evidence.text:
我去过几次。我会跳过他们的泰式炒河粉，我喜欢特定的口味，要么合你口味，要么不合。我喜欢的还有很多其他菜品，比如甜罗勒三文鱼或NomNom沙拉。我也看到过很多其他菜品飘过，我愿意尝试。

I have been in a couple of times. I would skip their Pad Thai, I like it a particular way and either you got it or you don't.  What I do like is a lot of other items, like the Sweet Basil Salmon or the NomNom salad. I have also seen plenty of other dishes float by that I am willing to try.

There expansion seems to have paid off  and its now much more comfortable to sit and stay a bit.

evidence.originalText: Love this place.  Good food, good beer selection and great atmosphere both inside and out on the deck!  Our one year old is content to sit on the deck for a few hours and they allow dogs, too.  Great place!

evidence.text: 我来这里是因为餐厅周，因为我住在这附近，经常路过。我原本觉得它更像一个酒店餐厅，但结果很棒！我绝对会再来的。因为是餐厅周，菜单有所不同，但我的主菜——三文鱼配藜麦和蔬菜——是我吃过最好的之一！！我吃得很饱，但还是吃完了。他们还在餐厅周搞活动，葡萄酒每瓶35美元，对于一家比较高档的餐厅来说相当不错。员工非常友好，唯一的问题是我们有一会儿找不到女主人安排座位。但我想她跑到后面去了，他们道了歉。总的来说，对传统美食进行了很棒的创新。很喜欢，等不及再来了。
evidence.originalText: I went here for restaurant week because I live in the area and always pass by. I definetly considered it more of a hotel restaurant, but it was wonderful! I would absolutely go back. It was a different menu because of restaurant week, but my entree of salmon over quinoa and veggies was one of hte best I've ever had!! I was so full but I had to finish it. They were also running a special for restaurant week where bottles of wine were $35, which i pretty decent for a more upscale place. The staff was very friendly, only issue was we could not find hte hostess for awhile to get seated. But I think she had ran in the back, and they apologized. Overall great inventive take on traditional cuisine. Loved it and cant wait to go back.

evidence.text:
单凭味道，这家店值得五颗星。他们的蟹腿棒极了。调味料是我吃过最好的之一。

但是他们做我点的10磅螃蟹花了超~~~久。当时是节假日，如果他们提前告诉我们蟹腿要几个小时才能做好，那就没问题了。我们可以等食物好了再回来，而不是在那里待上几个小时。他们说一小时……结果花了2-3小时。
evidence.originalText:
Taste alone, this place deserves 5 stars. Their crab legs were amazing. The seasoning was some of the best I have ever had. 

But they took foreeeeever to make the 10 lbs of crabs I ordered. It was holiday and wouldn't have been a problem if they let us know it would be hours before the crab legs were ready. We could have just come back when the food was ready instead of hanging out there for hours. They said an hour....it was 2-3 hours.

evidence.originalText: I stopped coming here 3 years ago . You wait 45 Mins or more for you to get waited on. When you call them they hang up the phone and play games with the phone sometimes it's busy . The ppl who work there are very angry . I reckon it's because they pay the workers poorly so they don't deliver as well as they should . Don't come here because you'll be very disappointed !

evidence.originalText:
Intimate setting, friendly staff, good coffee and delicious treats

The front room is cozy with big windows on two sides that let in ample sunlight and great neighborhood watching.  Staff is great, amicable and pleasant.  It is my favorite local cafe and I spend hours here working and chatting with staff, friends and neighbors.

evidence.text:
我一直想试试这个地方，因为它离我的实习地点很近。这是一个可爱的小地方，似乎适合工作几个小时或者只是放松一下。我进去时人群混杂，包括一个忙着用电脑的男人，以及一位母亲和她的孩子在享用早餐。我点单时还有另外几个人进进出出。

我对我点的制作精美的“幸运山羊”拿铁印象深刻……黑巧克力、榛子、海盐！非常美味。咖啡师在我看菜单时也很有耐心，人很好。我肯定会再回来尝试其他特色饮品，听起来都很棒，或者尝尝新鲜烘焙的糕点。我也对冰咖啡很好奇。

我建议他们更新网站！网站上还列着秋季特饮，我知道他们每个季节都有几款新的特饮！我很快会再来尝试菜单上的更多菜品！
evidence.originalText:
I had been wanting to try this place for a while as it was really close to my internship. It's a cute, tiny spot that seems good for getting a few hours of work done or even just chilling. The crowd when I walked in was mixed, it included a man busy at his computer as well as a mom & her child enjoying breakfast. A couple others came in and out while I was ordering as well. 

I was really impressed with the beautifully crafted "Lucky Goat" latte I ordered...Dark chocolate, hazelnut, sea salt! It was delicious The barista was also patient and nice as I looked over what to order. I would definitely be back to try the other special drinks which all sounded amazing or try some of the fresh baked pastries. I'm also curious about the iced coffee.

One suggestion I'd have is for them to update their website! The website still lists fall specials and I know they have a couple of new drink specials every season! I'll be back soon to try more items off the menu!

evidence.text:
在过去的二十年里，我一直告诉所有愿意听的人，南街的Ishkibibble's Eatery是我吃过的最好的芝士牛排。我去过其他一些地方，这里就不点名了，但没有一个能比得上Ishkibble's。

几个月前，几个朋友让我试试东北区的Chink's，在被反复催促后，我决定去尝一尝。

当我走进那家店，看到肉的质地和烹饪方式时，我就知道我要大饱口福了。果然，那块牛排和我吃过的任何东西都不一样。味道难以置信，牛排大小也很合适。就价格而言，简直是超值。我走出那家店时感觉像是占了他们的便宜！

我会一直爱Ishkibble's，但我不能再告诉别人那里有我最喜欢的芝士牛排了。这个桂冠现在属于Chink's！
evidence.originalText:
For  the better part of 20 years, I have been telling everyone who would listen that Ishkibibble's Eatery on South Street is the best cheesesteak I've ever had. I've been to other places I won't name here, but nothing came close to Ishkibble's.

A few months ago, I was told be a couple of friends to try out Chink's in the Northeast, and after been hounded repeatedly, I decided to give it a shot.

I knew when I walked into that place I was in for a treat, when I saw the texture of the meat and how it was cooked. Lo and behold, that steak was unlike anything I've EVER had. Incredible taste, and a nice size steak. For the price, it's a huge bargain. I walked out of that place feeling like I ripped THEM off!

I'll always love Ishkibble's, but I can no longer tell people they have my favorite cheesesteak. That crown now goes to Chinks!

Smiths是个很酷的聚会场所，啤酒选择丰富，氛围适合和朋友聊天。服务员很可爱。然而，我们吃的食物最多算一般，这很令人失望，因为食物选择看起来非常诱人。

我们点了两份不同口味的鸡翅。经典款和亚洲风味款，两者都没熟透，而且都不特别好吃。然后我们吃了芝士牛排春卷，还行。最后，我们吃了烧烤鸡肉扁面包。虽然不算难吃，但本可以更好。它比我们预想的大得多。

我们最后整晚都在喝酒。正如我所说，这是一个非常酷且独特的酒吧场景，如果你只是想喝鸡尾酒，Smiths是个好地方。
evidence.originalText:
Smiths is a cool hang out with a great selection of beer and a great atmosphere to chat with friends. The waitstaff is lovely. However, the food that we had was mediocre at best, which was disappointing because the food choices looked extremely appetizing. 

We had two orders of two different types of wings. We had the classic and an asian variety, both of which were undercooked and neither of which were particularly good. Then we had the cheesesteak spring rolls, which were okay. Lastly, we had the BBQ chicken flatbread. While it wasn't terrible, it could have been better. It was a lot larger than we had anticipated. 

We ended up staying all night drinking. As I said, it is a really cool and unique bar scene and if you are just looking to get cocktails, Smiths is a good spot.

那个秃顶的家伙可能看起来脾气不好。但他的服务迅速又到位。菜单上的菜品也是如此。这家店里面看起来可能像个破旧的小馆子。天热的时候在里面吃可能不太舒服。但这一切都很值得。

猪肉三明治别去Geno's或Pat's了。走到George's去吧！
evidence.originalText:
The balding guy may look crabby. But his service is prompt and on spot. As is the menu items. The place may look like a dive inside. And on a hot day it may be less than comfortable to eat inside. But it is all well worth it. 

My favorite is the Italian Sausage Sandwich. I always get the "Burn my ass" which is semi-hot for me. For vanilla folks it will burn. 

Also one can NEVER go wrong with the Pork Sandwich with Provolone. I even took a girl on our first date to this place for lunch. Yeah a bit low brow. But she still raves about the pork so all was well! 

Screw Geno's or Pat's for Pork. Take the walk to George's instead!

evidence.text: 我一直想知道什么时候人们才会意识到，我们都希望孩子能玩，而我们能吃饭喝酒！除了麦当劳……Craft Hall 是有小孩家庭的必去之地！如果你曾希望像以前一样出去玩，如果你曾渴望再次感觉酷……终于！你可以拥有一切！他们对我们的大家庭非常包容。我喜欢这里只有吧台服务——你想要水？自己去拿！番茄酱？在那边！是的！这就是有孩子的人想要的。让我们自己来，这样我们就不用等任何人！我的孩子们（1岁和3岁）喜欢这里的每一个细节。他们玩了3.5个小时，这比我们在其他地方待的时间多了整整2.5个小时！！！谢谢 Craft Hall——我们还会再来的！！！！
evidence.originalText:
I have been wondering when people would realize that we all want our kids to play while we eat/drink! Other than a McDonald's... 

Craft hall is a MUST for families with young kids! If you ever wished you could go out like you used to, if you ever yearned for feeling cool again... finally! You can have it all!

They were SO accommodating to the large group we had. I love that it is just bar service- you want water? Go get it! Ketchup? It's over there! YES! This is what people with kids want. Let us do it ourself so we don't have to wait for anyone! 

My kids loved every single detail about this place (1,3). They played for 3.5 hours, which is exactly 2.5 hours than we have ever managed to be anywhere else!!! 

Thank you craft hall -we will be back!!!!

evidence.originalText:
I've only been here once so far, but I enjoyed it!  It was packed when we were here but we were able to sit outside (which was preferable anyway, since the weather was beautiful!).  I took the crowds as a sign that the coffee was good, and I was right (way to go, Carissa!).

I find that many places that have fancy coffee make it look and taste way too dark.  The iced caramel coffee here was noticeably caffeinated, but didn't taste too strong and acidic, so that was a real treat.  I also appreciated the offering of vegan options in food and drinks.  

Really nothing negative to say here!  Someday I shall try some other foods/drinks, but for now at least, I'm a fan.

evidence.originalText:
This is a very minimalist coffee shop located on the southern boundaries of the wonderful Northern Liberties district. They serve coffee, first and foremost. They do  occasionally have snacks and pastries and the like by this is primarily a coffee shop. The staff was friendly and efficient, very knowledgeable about the coffee they were selling. 

The usual variety of espresso drinks and drip and pourovers are available. Coffee selection varies, but it's all locally roasted off site. The employees there were very friendly and service was excellent.

This is a great stop on the way to or from work, or just to duck out of the rain or cold. Overall highly recommended.

2. Service was SO fast  (forget spending 15 minutes in line at Starbucks!) but maybe because I was the only one there. They promptly made my drink and...even gave me suggestions on how to improve it. 

3. They're friendly. Maybe too friendly. I'm not one to sit and chat with the barista when I have to go to the office, I just want to grab a coffee and go. If you decide to visit, just follow the smell of fresh roasted beans and the sounds of Frank Sinatra wafting through the station. They play him really, really loud.

evidence.text:
在过去的二十年里，我一直告诉所有愿意听的人，南街的Ishkibibble's Eatery是我吃过的最好的芝士牛排。我去过其他一些地方，这里就不点名了，但没有一个能比得上Ishkibble's。

几个月前，几个朋友让我试试东北区的Chink's，在被反复催促后，我决定去尝一尝。

当我走进那家店，看到肉的质地和烹饪方式时，我就知道我要大饱口福了。果然，那块牛排和我吃过的任何东西都不一样。味道难以置信，牛排大小也很合适。就价格而言，简直是超值。我走出那家店时感觉像是占了他们的便宜！

我会一直爱Ishkibble's，但我不能再告诉别人那里有我最喜欢的芝士牛排了。这个桂冠现在属于Chink's！
evidence.originalText:
For  the better part of 20 years, I have been telling everyone who would listen that Ishkibibble's Eatery on South Street is the best cheesesteak I've ever had. I've been to other places I won't name here, but nothing came close to Ishkibble's.

A few months ago, I was told be a couple of friends to try out Chink's in the Northeast, and after been hounded repeatedly, I decided to give it a shot.

I knew when I walked into that place I was in for a treat, when I saw the texture of the meat and how it was cooked. Lo and behold, that steak was unlike anything I've EVER had. Incredible taste, and a nice size steak. For the price, it's a huge bargain. I walked out of that place feeling like I ripped THEM off!

I'll always love Ishkibble's, but I can no longer tell people they have my favorite cheesesteak. That crown now goes to Chinks!

Smiths是个很酷的聚会场所，啤酒选择丰富，氛围适合和朋友聊天。服务员很可爱。然而，我们吃的食物最多算一般，这很令人失望，因为食物选择看起来非常诱人。

我们点了两份不同口味的鸡翅。经典款和亚洲风味款，两者都没熟透，而且都不特别好吃。然后我们吃了芝士牛排春卷，还行。最后，我们吃了烧烤鸡肉扁面包。虽然不算难吃，但本可以更好。它比我们预想的大得多。

我们最后整晚都在喝酒。正如我所说，这是一个非常酷且独特的酒吧场景，如果你只是想喝鸡尾酒，Smiths是个好地方。
evidence.originalText:
Smiths is a cool hang out with a great selection of beer and a great atmosphere to chat with friends. The waitstaff is lovely. However, the food that we had was mediocre at best, which was disappointing because the food choices looked extremely appetizing. 

We had two orders of two different types of wings. We had the classic and an asian variety, both of which were undercooked and neither of which were particularly good. Then we had the cheesesteak spring rolls, which were okay. Lastly, we had the BBQ chicken flatbread. While it wasn't terrible, it could have been better. It was a lot larger than we had anticipated. 

We ended up staying all night drinking. As I said, it is a really cool and unique bar scene and if you are just looking to get cocktails, Smiths is a good spot.

evidence.text:
费城最喜欢的地方，就在 Headhouse 广场！氛围很棒，楼下非常舒适，每周大部分晚上都有原声音乐表演。是喝一杯、放松身心的好去处。楼上的酒吧更热闹，有稳定的蓝调和摇滚乐队，旁边的俱乐部房间有沙狐球、飞镖和壁炉旁的沙发，是和朋友们一起放松的有趣地方。

他们有不错的生啤酒，鸡尾酒也是一流的。我大多在酒吧吃小盘菜和开胃菜，都很美味（小龙虾通心粉奶酪是我的首选）。

最重要的是——服务很好，员工很棒。他们不遗余力地让你感到舒适和“宾至如归”。
evidence.originalText:
A favorite spot in Philly, right on Headhouse Square!  The atmosphere is great with a very cozy downstairs with live acoustic music most nights of the week.  Perfect place to meet up for a drink and low key relaxation.  The upstairs bar provides a more lively time with consistently good blues and rock bands and the adjacent club room is complete with shuffle board, darts, and couches by a fireplace, a fun place to chill with friends. 

They have good beers on tap and the cocktails are top notch.  I mostly snack on their small plates and appetizers while at the bar, all of which are delicious (crawfish mac-n-cheese is my go-to). 

Most importantly - the service is great with awesome staff.  They go the extra mile to make you feel comfortable and "at home".

evidence.text: 我一直想知道什么时候人们才会意识到，我们都希望孩子能玩，而我们能吃饭喝酒！除了麦当劳……Craft Hall 是有小孩家庭的必去之地！如果你曾希望像以前一样出去玩，如果你曾渴望再次感觉酷……终于！你可以拥有一切！他们对我们的大家庭非常包容。我喜欢这里只有吧台服务——你想要水？自己去拿！番茄酱？在那边！是的！这就是有孩子的人想要的。让我们自己来，这样我们就不用等任何人！我的孩子们（1岁和3岁）喜欢这里的每一个细节。他们玩了3.5个小时，这比我们在其他地方待的时间多了整整2.5个小时！！！谢谢 Craft Hall——我们还会再来的！！！！
evidence.originalText:
I have been wondering when people would realize that we all want our kids to play while we eat/drink! Other than a McDonald's... 

Craft hall is a MUST for families with young kids! If you ever wished you could go out like you used to, if you ever yearned for feeling cool again... finally! You can have it all!

They were SO accommodating to the large group we had. I love that it is just bar service- you want water? Go get it! Ketchup? It's over there! YES! This is what people with kids want. Let us do it ourself so we don't have to wait for anyone! 

My kids loved every single detail about this place (1,3). They played for 3.5 hours, which is exactly 2.5 hours than we have ever managed to be anywhere else!!! 

Thank you craft hall -we will be back!!!!

I find that many places that have fancy coffee make it look and taste way too dark.  The iced caramel coffee here was noticeably caffeinated, but didn't taste too strong and acidic, so that was a real treat.  I also appreciated the offering of vegan options in food and drinks.  

Really nothing negative to say here!  Someday I shall try some other foods/drinks, but for now at least, I'm a fan.

details.question: 我对咖啡不太懂，想找一家店员愿意耐心介绍、不会让新手尴尬的咖啡店。

evidence.text:
首先我必须承认：我不喝咖啡。这辈子一滴都没喝过。找到一家同样照顾非咖啡爱好者的咖啡店可能是个挑战。这个炎热的周日下午我本打算去别的地方，但那里因为假日周末关门了。Yelp帮我找到了Red Hook。和另一位评论者一样，我注意到我走进去时员工正坐着和朋友聊天，但她立刻站起来帮助我。她推荐了伯爵茶加焦糖拿铁。这是个很棒的选择。味道很好……而且我自己绝不会想到这个搭配。

我对Red Hook的一个（也许是两个）问题是，这个地方感觉有点像去一个大学生合租的房子。不配套的家具很可爱，但破旧且脏。到处都是灰尘和污垢。而且，可能因为外面热和频繁开门，有很多虫子。他们也没有空调。点热饮是我的错，但话说回来……咖啡店应该让人感到舒适：冬天暖和，夏天凉爽。

我可能会再来喝别的饮料，但大概不会久坐。
evidence.originalText:
So I must first admit: I don't drink coffee.  Never had a drop in my life.  Finding a coffee shop that caters as much to the non-coffee drinkers can be a challenge.  I was expecting to go elsewhere on this hot Sunday afternoon, but it was closed for the holiday weekend.  Yelp helped me find Red Hook.  Like another reviewer, I noticed that the staff was sitting chatting with friends when I walked in, but she stood right up to assist me.  She offered her recommendation for an Earl Grey with Caramel Latte.  It was a great choice.  Good flavor... and something I never would've considered on my own.

My one (maybe two) issues with Red Hook is that the place feels a bit like visiting a college kid's shared house.  The mismatched furniture is cute, but worn and dirty.  There was dust and dirt everywhere.  And, probably due to the heat outside and frequent door openings, lots of bugs.  They also didn't have air conditioning.  My fault for ordering a hot drink, but still... a coffee shop should feel cozy: warm in the winter and cool in the summer.

I may come back for additional drinks, but probably not for sitting for any length of time.

evidence.text:
友好热情的氛氛围、员工和老板，加上非常合理的价格，使这里成为我最喜欢的社区咖啡馆。唯一能让它更好的是有本地面包师提供无麸质烘焙食品出售。

咖啡很好。非常好。他们卖La Colombe咖啡，而且知道怎么制作。他们还有十多种不错的茶选择，少量但精心挑选的烘焙食品、带奶油芝士和熏鲑鱼或其他配料的百吉饼，偶尔还有新鲜水果如香蕉出售，虽然绝对不是一顿完整的午餐。我听说百吉饼很棒。他们已经解决了饮品菜单的问题（另一条评论中提到散乱不清），墙上有一个清晰的横幅，我发现如果你问，他们总能想办法做出来。

有一个小的户外座位区，配有金属框架沙发和柔软干净的靠垫。非常适合春天和夏天，也是在这里社区结交新朋友的好地方。

前厅是一个放松的区域，可以工作、见人、和老板聊天（她在的时候），听她讲述她旅行丰富的生活故事。虽然她有时在工作时安静而不张扬，所以你可能需要主动提问才能让她开口。

员工也类似：安静、礼貌、高效、友好。问个问题，开始对话，他们就有丰富的生活经历可以分享。事实上，我在这里搭过话的大多数人都很有趣、有创意、鼓舞人心。也许是社区的原因，也许是咖啡因的作用，这里有些特别的东西。不装腔作势，从没见过男士发髻，人们真的会微笑。这很好。

后面有一个房间，有棋盘游戏、一张柔软干净的沙发和两把舒适的椅子，布置得像客厅/会客室，还有一张餐桌和椅子，非常适合学习小组和商务会议。

再加点俗气的话……作为摩羯座，我是发现这颗宝石的幸运山羊！;)
evidence.originalText:
The friendly and welcoming vibe, staff, and owner, combined with their very reasonable prices make this my favorite neighborhood coffeeshop. The only thing that would make it better would be having a local baker providing gluten free baked goods for sale here. 

Coffee is good. Very good. They carry La Colombe. And they know how to make it. They have 10 or more nice tea selections as well, a small but cared for selection of baked goods, bagals with cream cheese and lox or other toppings, and occasionally fresh fruit like a banana for sale, though it's not a full spread lunch spot by any means. I hear the bagels are fantastic.  They have remedied their drink menu issue (mentioned in another review as scattered and unclear) with a clear banner on the wall, and I find if you ask they can find a way to make it. 

There is a small outside sitting area with outdoor metal frame couches with soft clean cushions. Perfect for spring and summer days, and great spot to make new friends here in the neighborhood. 

The front room is a chill zone to work, meet people, chat with the owner when she's here, and listen to her stories of her well traveled life. Though she's sometimes quiet and unassuming while working here so you may have to be the one asking the questions to get her going.  

The staff are similar; quiet, polite, efficient, and friendly. Ask a question, start a conversation, and they're full of great life experiences to share. In fact, most of the people I've ever struck up a conversation with here have been interesting, creative, and inspiring. Maybe it's the neighborhood, maybe it's partly the caffeine, there is something special here. Un pretentious, haven't seen a man-bun ever here, and people actually smile here. That's nice.

There is a back room with board games, a soft clean sofa and 2 comfy chairs set up like a living room/sitting parlour, and a dining table and chairs, great for study groups and business meetings. 

And to add a bit of cheese...as a Capricorn, I am the Lucky Goat for finding this gem! ;)

evidence.text:
很棒的小咖啡店。

可爱、舒适的氛围。很容易坐下来工作——这是我喜欢咖啡店的关键。有很多自然光，夏天前面有户外座位，后面也有一个小露台。后面有一张很大的桌子，如果有空间，你可以展开翅膀工作！

员工很酷。有一个女咖啡师相当不友好，幸好她只在我去的时候工作过一次。和其他员工的互动都很好！

饮品：好吃！"Lucky Goat"一定要试试。我喝了一次就上瘾了。滴滤咖啡也很好喝，如果你不想花大价钱买花式饮料的话。其他特色饮品和茶看起来也不错。有一种加了玫瑰的，味道很好，因为你能真正尝到玫瑰味，不像有些地方有'酷'的配料但你根本尝不出来——那有什么意义呢？！

食物：糕点是不错的享受。他们还有很好的百吉饼配奶油奶酪选择。

停车：路边免费停车，而且从未遇到过找不到近处车位的问题。
evidence.originalText:
Great little coffee shop. 

Cute, cozy atmosphere. It's easy to post up and get work done- a key to coffee shops that I love. There is lots of natural light and in the summer they have outside seating in the front as well as a smaller patio in the back. In the back there is a really large table so if there is room you can spread your wings and work!

Staff is cool. There was one barista (woman) who was pretty unfriendly, thankfully she was only working 1 of the times I was there. The rest of my interactions with other staff have been great!

Dranks: YUM! The "Lucky Goat" is a must try. Once I had it, I was hooked. The drip coffee is yummy too if you aren't into spending the absurd amount of $ on a fancy drink. There other specialty drinks and teas look great too. There is one with rose in it and it was nice because you could actually taste the rose, vs some places have 'cool' ingredients but you can't ever taste them- WHAT'S THE POINT PEOPLE?!

Food: Pastries are a good treat. And they have a nice selection of bagels with cream cheese too.

evidence.text: 今年我圣诞愿望清单的第一项，是有人能在我家附近开一家巨大、友好、有 WiFi、有很多插座、空间宽敞的咖啡馆。现在还没有实现，但有人在 Washington West 开了一家，这完全不公平，因为从 Good Karma 走到 Chapterhouse 那一带的好地方也很方便。我先压住自己的怨念，只庆幸如果我真的急着去咖啡馆，可以比以前少走整整两个街区。Good Karma 很大、很明亮，有很多插座和 WiFi。除了咖啡和茶之外，还有很多烘焙食品和其他饮品可选，这点不错。他们还有两个不错的洗手间，也没人打扰你，而且营业到很晚。这会是咖啡馆之爱吗？缺点是食物不算好。店里有牌子告诉你不要带外食，我必须尊重，但我也必须承认，当我咬下一块湿润、蛋味过重的司康时，想到外面有 Metropolitan Bakery 做的那些优秀司康，心里会有点难过。就普通滴滤咖啡来说，咖啡还可以，但正如另一位 Yelp 用户说的，拿铁差很多。他们似乎分不清拿铁和卡布奇诺。我点过一次，之后就再也没点过。可我能说什么呢。为了这里真正友好的氛围，我可以忍受糟糕的司康和普通的咖啡饮品；一想到这个街区如此被宠坏，而我住的那片完全没有这种优秀咖啡馆，我嫉妒得脸都像他们的杯子一样绿了。哦，只收现金，不过店内有一台手续费很贵的 ATM。
evidence.originalText:
At the top of my Christmas list this year is that someone would open a huge, friendly coffeehouse near my house with WiFi and plenty of outlets and a lot of room. It hasn't happened yet but someone opened one up in Washington West which is totally not fair since Good Karma is an easy walk from the awesomeness of Chapterhouse.

I'll forestall my bitterness for now and just be glad that I can stop walking a whole two blocks than before if I really must be at a coffeehouse that much sooner. Good Karma is BIG and bright and has a lot of outlets and WiFi. There's a large selection of baked good and drinks other than coffee and tea. That's cool. They have two nice bathrooms, too, and no one bothers you and they're open late. Could this be coffeehouse love?

The downsides are the food's not great. There's a sign telling you not to bring food from elsewhere which I must respect but I must admit to being a little sad inside when I have to bite into one of their moist, overly eggy scones knowing there are great ones out there made by our own Metropolitan Bakery. The coffee's fine, as far as a brew is concerned but as a fellow Yelper said, the lattes leave much to be desired. They're confused as to what makes a latte and what makes a cappuccino. I ordered one once and none since. 

But what can I say. I'll take the bad scones and indifferent coffee drinks for the genuine friendliness of the place and my face is as green as their mugs when I think about how spoiled that neighborhood is while my part of town is totally bereft of coffeehouse awesomeness.

Oh, cash only though there's an expensive ATM on the premises.

evidence.text:
友好热情的氛氛围、员工和老板，加上非常合理的价格，使这里成为我最喜欢的社区咖啡馆。唯一能让它更好的是有本地面包师提供无麸质烘焙食品出售。

咖啡很好。非常好。他们卖La Colombe咖啡，而且知道怎么制作。他们还有十多种不错的茶选择，少量但精心挑选的烘焙食品、带奶油芝士和熏鲑鱼或其他配料的百吉饼，偶尔还有新鲜水果如香蕉出售，虽然绝对不是一顿完整的午餐。我听说百吉饼很棒。他们已经解决了饮品菜单的问题（另一条评论中提到散乱不清），墙上有一个清晰的横幅，我发现如果你问，他们总能想办法做出来。

有一个小的户外座位区，配有金属框架沙发和柔软干净的靠垫。非常适合春天和夏天，也是在这里社区结交新朋友的好地方。

前厅是一个放松的区域，可以工作、见人、和老板聊天（她在的时候），听她讲述她旅行丰富的生活故事。虽然她有时在工作时安静而不张扬，所以你可能需要主动提问才能让她开口。

员工也类似：安静、礼貌、高效、友好。问个问题，开始对话，他们就有丰富的生活经历可以分享。事实上，我在这里搭过话的大多数人都很有趣、有创意、鼓舞人心。也许是社区的原因，也许是咖啡因的作用，这里有些特别的东西。不装腔作势，从没见过男士发髻，人们真的会微笑。这很好。

后面有一个房间，有棋盘游戏、一张柔软干净的沙发和两把舒适的椅子，布置得像客厅/会客室，还有一张餐桌和椅子，非常适合学习小组和商务会议。

再加点俗气的话……作为摩羯座，我是发现这颗宝石的幸运山羊！;)
evidence.originalText:
The friendly and welcoming vibe, staff, and owner, combined with their very reasonable prices make this my favorite neighborhood coffeeshop. The only thing that would make it better would be having a local baker providing gluten free baked goods for sale here. 

Coffee is good. Very good. They carry La Colombe. And they know how to make it. They have 10 or more nice tea selections as well, a small but cared for selection of baked goods, bagals with cream cheese and lox or other toppings, and occasionally fresh fruit like a banana for sale, though it's not a full spread lunch spot by any means. I hear the bagels are fantastic.  They have remedied their drink menu issue (mentioned in another review as scattered and unclear) with a clear banner on the wall, and I find if you ask they can find a way to make it. 

There is a small outside sitting area with outdoor metal frame couches with soft clean cushions. Perfect for spring and summer days, and great spot to make new friends here in the neighborhood. 

The front room is a chill zone to work, meet people, chat with the owner when she's here, and listen to her stories of her well traveled life. Though she's sometimes quiet and unassuming while working here so you may have to be the one asking the questions to get her going.  

The staff are similar; quiet, polite, efficient, and friendly. Ask a question, start a conversation, and they're full of great life experiences to share. In fact, most of the people I've ever struck up a conversation with here have been interesting, creative, and inspiring. Maybe it's the neighborhood, maybe it's partly the caffeine, there is something special here. Un pretentious, haven't seen a man-bun ever here, and people actually smile here. That's nice.

There is a back room with board games, a soft clean sofa and 2 comfy chairs set up like a living room/sitting parlour, and a dining table and chairs, great for study groups and business meetings. 

And to add a bit of cheese...as a Capricorn, I am the Lucky Goat for finding this gem! ;)

I've gotten the honeybee crepe (mozzarella, spinach, egg, honey drizzled on top) and the goat bacon (goat cheese, bacon, mushrooms, tomato) and both were delicious and very fresh. Thanks for existing, guys.

I had been wanting to try this place for a while as it was really close to my internship. It's a cute, tiny spot that seems good for getting a few hours of work done or even just chilling. The crowd when I walked in was mixed, it included a man busy at his computer as well as a mom & her child enjoying breakfast. A couple others came in and out while I was ordering as well. 

I was really impressed with the beautifully crafted "Lucky Goat" latte I ordered...Dark chocolate, hazelnut, sea salt! It was delicious The barista was also patient and nice as I looked over what to order. I would definitely be back to try the other special drinks which all sounded amazing or try some of the fresh baked pastries. I'm also curious about the iced coffee.

One suggestion I'd have is for them to update their website! The website still lists fall specials and I know they have a couple of new drink specials every season! I'll be back soon to try more items off the menu!

I find that many places that have fancy coffee make it look and taste way too dark.  The iced caramel coffee here was noticeably caffeinated, but didn't taste too strong and acidic, so that was a real treat.  I also appreciated the offering of vegan options in food and drinks.  

Really nothing negative to say here!  Someday I shall try some other foods/drinks, but for now at least, I'm a fan.

evidence.originalText:
For  the better part of 20 years, I have been telling everyone who would listen that Ishkibibble's Eatery on South Street is the best cheesesteak I've ever had. I've been to other places I won't name here, but nothing came close to Ishkibble's.

A few months ago, I was told be a couple of friends to try out Chink's in the Northeast, and after been hounded repeatedly, I decided to give it a shot.

I knew when I walked into that place I was in for a treat, when I saw the texture of the meat and how it was cooked. Lo and behold, that steak was unlike anything I've EVER had. Incredible taste, and a nice size steak. For the price, it's a huge bargain. I walked out of that place feeling like I ripped THEM off!

I'll always love Ishkibble's, but I can no longer tell people they have my favorite cheesesteak. That crown now goes to Chinks!

我们点了两份不同口味的鸡翅。经典款和亚洲风味款，两者都没熟透，而且都不特别好吃。然后我们吃了芝士牛排春卷，还行。最后，我们吃了烧烤鸡肉扁面包。虽然不算难吃，但本可以更好。它比我们预想的大得多。

我们最后整晚都在喝酒。正如我所说，这是一个非常酷且独特的酒吧场景，如果你只是想喝鸡尾酒，Smiths是个好地方。
evidence.originalText:
Smiths is a cool hang out with a great selection of beer and a great atmosphere to chat with friends. The waitstaff is lovely. However, the food that we had was mediocre at best, which was disappointing because the food choices looked extremely appetizing. 

We had two orders of two different types of wings. We had the classic and an asian variety, both of which were undercooked and neither of which were particularly good. Then we had the cheesesteak spring rolls, which were okay. Lastly, we had the BBQ chicken flatbread. While it wasn't terrible, it could have been better. It was a lot larger than we had anticipated. 

We ended up staying all night drinking. As I said, it is a really cool and unique bar scene and if you are just looking to get cocktails, Smiths is a good spot.

evidence.text:
费城最喜欢的地方，就在 Headhouse 广场！氛围很棒，楼下非常舒适，每周大部分晚上都有原声音乐表演。是喝一杯、放松身心的好去处。楼上的酒吧更热闹，有稳定的蓝调和摇滚乐队，旁边的俱乐部房间有沙狐球、飞镖和壁炉旁的沙发，是和朋友们一起放松的有趣地方。

他们有不错的生啤酒，鸡尾酒也是一流的。我大多在酒吧吃小盘菜和开胃菜，都很美味（小龙虾通心粉奶酪是我的首选）。

最重要的是——服务很好，员工很棒。他们不遗余力地让你感到舒适和“宾至如归”。
evidence.originalText:
A favorite spot in Philly, right on Headhouse Square!  The atmosphere is great with a very cozy downstairs with live acoustic music most nights of the week.  Perfect place to meet up for a drink and low key relaxation.  The upstairs bar provides a more lively time with consistently good blues and rock bands and the adjacent club room is complete with shuffle board, darts, and couches by a fireplace, a fun place to chill with friends. 

They have good beers on tap and the cocktails are top notch.  I mostly snack on their small plates and appetizers while at the bar, all of which are delicious (crawfish mac-n-cheese is my go-to). 

Most importantly - the service is great with awesome staff.  They go the extra mile to make you feel comfortable and "at home".

evidence.text: 我一直想知道什么时候人们才会意识到，我们都希望孩子能玩，而我们能吃饭喝酒！除了麦当劳……Craft Hall 是有小孩家庭的必去之地！如果你曾希望像以前一样出去玩，如果你曾渴望再次感觉酷……终于！你可以拥有一切！他们对我们的大家庭非常包容。我喜欢这里只有吧台服务——你想要水？自己去拿！番茄酱？在那边！是的！这就是有孩子的人想要的。让我们自己来，这样我们就不用等任何人！我的孩子们（1岁和3岁）喜欢这里的每一个细节。他们玩了3.5个小时，这比我们在其他地方待的时间多了整整2.5个小时！！！谢谢 Craft Hall——我们还会再来的！！！！
evidence.originalText:
I have been wondering when people would realize that we all want our kids to play while we eat/drink! Other than a McDonald's... 

Craft hall is a MUST for families with young kids! If you ever wished you could go out like you used to, if you ever yearned for feeling cool again... finally! You can have it all!

They were SO accommodating to the large group we had. I love that it is just bar service- you want water? Go get it! Ketchup? It's over there! YES! This is what people with kids want. Let us do it ourself so we don't have to wait for anyone! 

My kids loved every single detail about this place (1,3). They played for 3.5 hours, which is exactly 2.5 hours than we have ever managed to be anywhere else!!! 

Thank you craft hall -we will be back!!!!

evidence.originalText:
I've only been here once so far, but I enjoyed it!  It was packed when we were here but we were able to sit outside (which was preferable anyway, since the weather was beautiful!).  I took the crowds as a sign that the coffee was good, and I was right (way to go, Carissa!).

I find that many places that have fancy coffee make it look and taste way too dark.  The iced caramel coffee here was noticeably caffeinated, but didn't taste too strong and acidic, so that was a real treat.  I also appreciated the offering of vegan options in food and drinks.  

Really nothing negative to say here!  Someday I shall try some other foods/drinks, but for now at least, I'm a fan.

evidence.text:
友好热情的氛氛围、员工和老板，加上非常合理的价格，使这里成为我最喜欢的社区咖啡馆。唯一能让它更好的是有本地面包师提供无麸质烘焙食品出售。

咖啡很好。非常好。他们卖La Colombe咖啡，而且知道怎么制作。他们还有十多种不错的茶选择，少量但精心挑选的烘焙食品、带奶油芝士和熏鲑鱼或其他配料的百吉饼，偶尔还有新鲜水果如香蕉出售，虽然绝对不是一顿完整的午餐。我听说百吉饼很棒。他们已经解决了饮品菜单的问题（另一条评论中提到散乱不清），墙上有一个清晰的横幅，我发现如果你问，他们总能想办法做出来。

有一个小的户外座位区，配有金属框架沙发和柔软干净的靠垫。非常适合春天和夏天，也是在这里社区结交新朋友的好地方。

前厅是一个放松的区域，可以工作、见人、和老板聊天（她在的时候），听她讲述她旅行丰富的生活故事。虽然她有时在工作时安静而不张扬，所以你可能需要主动提问才能让她开口。

员工也类似：安静、礼貌、高效、友好。问个问题，开始对话，他们就有丰富的生活经历可以分享。事实上，我在这里搭过话的大多数人都很有趣、有创意、鼓舞人心。也许是社区的原因，也许是咖啡因的作用，这里有些特别的东西。不装腔作势，从没见过男士发髻，人们真的会微笑。这很好。

后面有一个房间，有棋盘游戏、一张柔软干净的沙发和两把舒适的椅子，布置得像客厅/会客室，还有一张餐桌和椅子，非常适合学习小组和商务会议。

再加点俗气的话……作为摩羯座，我是发现这颗宝石的幸运山羊！;)
evidence.originalText:
The friendly and welcoming vibe, staff, and owner, combined with their very reasonable prices make this my favorite neighborhood coffeeshop. The only thing that would make it better would be having a local baker providing gluten free baked goods for sale here. 

Coffee is good. Very good. They carry La Colombe. And they know how to make it. They have 10 or more nice tea selections as well, a small but cared for selection of baked goods, bagals with cream cheese and lox or other toppings, and occasionally fresh fruit like a banana for sale, though it's not a full spread lunch spot by any means. I hear the bagels are fantastic.  They have remedied their drink menu issue (mentioned in another review as scattered and unclear) with a clear banner on the wall, and I find if you ask they can find a way to make it. 

There is a small outside sitting area with outdoor metal frame couches with soft clean cushions. Perfect for spring and summer days, and great spot to make new friends here in the neighborhood. 

The front room is a chill zone to work, meet people, chat with the owner when she's here, and listen to her stories of her well traveled life. Though she's sometimes quiet and unassuming while working here so you may have to be the one asking the questions to get her going.  

The staff are similar; quiet, polite, efficient, and friendly. Ask a question, start a conversation, and they're full of great life experiences to share. In fact, most of the people I've ever struck up a conversation with here have been interesting, creative, and inspiring. Maybe it's the neighborhood, maybe it's partly the caffeine, there is something special here. Un pretentious, haven't seen a man-bun ever here, and people actually smile here. That's nice.

There is a back room with board games, a soft clean sofa and 2 comfy chairs set up like a living room/sitting parlour, and a dining table and chairs, great for study groups and business meetings. 

And to add a bit of cheese...as a Capricorn, I am the Lucky Goat for finding this gem! ;)

evidence.text:
很棒的小咖啡店。

可爱、舒适的氛围。很容易坐下来工作——这是我喜欢咖啡店的关键。有很多自然光，夏天前面有户外座位，后面也有一个小露台。后面有一张很大的桌子，如果有空间，你可以展开翅膀工作！

员工很酷。有一个女咖啡师相当不友好，幸好她只在我去的时候工作过一次。和其他员工的互动都很好！

饮品：好吃！"Lucky Goat"一定要试试。我喝了一次就上瘾了。滴滤咖啡也很好喝，如果你不想花大价钱买花式饮料的话。其他特色饮品和茶看起来也不错。有一种加了玫瑰的，味道很好，因为你能真正尝到玫瑰味，不像有些地方有'酷'的配料但你根本尝不出来——那有什么意义呢？！

食物：糕点是不错的享受。他们还有很好的百吉饼配奶油奶酪选择。

停车：路边免费停车，而且从未遇到过找不到近处车位的问题。
evidence.originalText:
Great little coffee shop. 

Cute, cozy atmosphere. It's easy to post up and get work done- a key to coffee shops that I love. There is lots of natural light and in the summer they have outside seating in the front as well as a smaller patio in the back. In the back there is a really large table so if there is room you can spread your wings and work!

Staff is cool. There was one barista (woman) who was pretty unfriendly, thankfully she was only working 1 of the times I was there. The rest of my interactions with other staff have been great!

Dranks: YUM! The "Lucky Goat" is a must try. Once I had it, I was hooked. The drip coffee is yummy too if you aren't into spending the absurd amount of $ on a fancy drink. There other specialty drinks and teas look great too. There is one with rose in it and it was nice because you could actually taste the rose, vs some places have 'cool' ingredients but you can't ever taste them- WHAT'S THE POINT PEOPLE?!

很棒的小咖啡店。

可爱、舒适的氛围。很容易坐下来工作——这是我喜欢咖啡店的关键。有很多自然光，夏天前面有户外座位，后面也有一个小露台。后面有一张很大的桌子，如果有空间，你可以展开翅膀工作！

员工很酷。有一个女咖啡师相当不友好，幸好她只在我去的时候工作过一次。和其他员工的互动都很好！

饮品：好吃！"Lucky Goat"一定要试试。我喝了一次就上瘾了。滴滤咖啡也很好喝，如果你不想花大价钱买花式饮料的话。其他特色饮品和茶看起来也不错。有一种加了玫瑰的，味道很好，因为你能真正尝到玫瑰味，不像有些地方有'酷'的配料但你根本尝不出来——那有什么意义呢？！

食物：糕点是不错的享受。他们还有很好的百吉饼配奶油奶酪选择。

停车：路边免费停车，而且从未遇到过找不到近处车位的问题。

首先我必须承认：我不喝咖啡。这辈子一滴都没喝过。找到一家同样照顾非咖啡爱好者的咖啡店可能是个挑战。这个炎热的周日下午我本打算去别的地方，但那里因为假日周末关门了。Yelp帮我找到了Red Hook。和另一位评论者一样，我注意到我走进去时员工正坐着和朋友聊天，但她立刻站起来帮助我。她推荐了伯爵茶加焦糖拿铁。这是个很棒的选择。味道很好……而且我自己绝不会想到这个搭配。

我对Red Hook的一个（也许是两个）问题是，这个地方感觉有点像去一个大学生合租的房子。不配套的家具很可爱，但破旧且脏。到处都是灰尘和污垢。而且，可能因为外面热和频繁开门，有很多虫子。他们也没有空调。点热饮是我的错，但话说回来……咖啡店应该让人感到舒适：冬天暖和，夏天凉爽。

我可能会再来喝别的饮料，但大概不会久坐。
evidence.originalText:
So I must first admit: I don't drink coffee.  Never had a drop in my life.  Finding a coffee shop that caters as much to the non-coffee drinkers can be a challenge.  I was expecting to go elsewhere on this hot Sunday afternoon, but it was closed for the holiday weekend.  Yelp helped me find Red Hook.  Like another reviewer, I noticed that the staff was sitting chatting with friends when I walked in, but she stood right up to assist me.  She offered her recommendation for an Earl Grey with Caramel Latte.  It was a great choice.  Good flavor... and something I never would've considered on my own.

My one (maybe two) issues with Red Hook is that the place feels a bit like visiting a college kid's shared house.  The mismatched furniture is cute, but worn and dirty.  There was dust and dirt everywhere.  And, probably due to the heat outside and frequent door openings, lots of bugs.  They also didn't have air conditioning.  My fault for ordering a hot drink, but still... a coffee shop should feel cozy: warm in the winter and cool in the summer.

I may come back for additional drinks, but probably not for sitting for any length of time.

这周在这片区域工作，我很高兴在Yelp上搜咖啡时发现这家店只有两个街区远。我已经尝了很多——开心果拿铁、印度奶茶、手冲咖啡、冰咖啡和浓缩咖啡，还有Au Fornil面包店的美味糕点。喜欢蓝莓挞和咖啡蛋糕。咖啡师都非常友好，我快打烊时来，他们仍然帮我，服务超乎预期。

当我寻找本地咖啡店时，我会列一个需求清单，这家店满足了一切：
友好的员工、免费的水、舒适的座位、好吃的糕点，以及距离近。他们还有一个小商品区，卖版画、T恤、帽子等本地特色。喜欢这个区域的新增店铺，很高兴找到了我最爱的咖啡店！
evidence.originalText:
Working in the area this week, I was so happy to pop coffee into Yelp and find this place only two blocks away. I have already tried a lot- Pistachio latte, chai, pour over, iced coffee, and espresso, as well as the delicious pastries from Au Fornil bakery. Love the blueberry tarte and coffee cake. The baristas are all super friendly, and when I came around closing time, they still helped me out, going above and beyond. 

When I look for a local coffee shop, I make a checklist of things I need, and this place checks off everything: 
Friendly staff, free water, comfy seating, good pastries, and proximity. They also have a lil merch section with prints, shirts, hats etc for local appeal. Love the addition to the area, and so happy to find my new favorite coffee shop!

evidence.text: 今年我圣诞愿望清单的第一项，是有人能在我家附近开一家巨大、友好、有 WiFi、有很多插座、空间宽敞的咖啡馆。现在还没有实现，但有人在 Washington West 开了一家，这完全不公平，因为从 Good Karma 走到 Chapterhouse 那一带的好地方也很方便。我先压住自己的怨念，只庆幸如果我真的急着去咖啡馆，可以比以前少走整整两个街区。Good Karma 很大、很明亮，有很多插座和 WiFi。除了咖啡和茶之外，还有很多烘焙食品和其他饮品可选，这点不错。他们还有两个不错的洗手间，也没人打扰你，而且营业到很晚。这会是咖啡馆之爱吗？缺点是食物不算好。店里有牌子告诉你不要带外食，我必须尊重，但我也必须承认，当我咬下一块湿润、蛋味过重的司康时，想到外面有 Metropolitan Bakery 做的那些优秀司康，心里会有点难过。就普通滴滤咖啡来说，咖啡还可以，但正如另一位 Yelp 用户说的，拿铁差很多。他们似乎分不清拿铁和卡布奇诺。我点过一次，之后就再也没点过。可我能说什么呢。为了这里真正友好的氛围，我可以忍受糟糕的司康和普通的咖啡饮品；一想到这个街区如此被宠坏，而我住的那片完全没有这种优秀咖啡馆，我嫉妒得脸都像他们的杯子一样绿了。哦，只收现金，不过店内有一台手续费很贵的 ATM。
evidence.originalText:
At the top of my Christmas list this year is that someone would open a huge, friendly coffeehouse near my house with WiFi and plenty of outlets and a lot of room. It hasn't happened yet but someone opened one up in Washington West which is totally not fair since Good Karma is an easy walk from the awesomeness of Chapterhouse.

I'll forestall my bitterness for now and just be glad that I can stop walking a whole two blocks than before if I really must be at a coffeehouse that much sooner. Good Karma is BIG and bright and has a lot of outlets and WiFi. There's a large selection of baked good and drinks other than coffee and tea. That's cool. They have two nice bathrooms, too, and no one bothers you and they're open late. Could this be coffeehouse love?

The downsides are the food's not great. There's a sign telling you not to bring food from elsewhere which I must respect but I must admit to being a little sad inside when I have to bite into one of their moist, overly eggy scones knowing there are great ones out there made by our own Metropolitan Bakery. The coffee's fine, as far as a brew is concerned but as a fellow Yelper said, the lattes leave much to be desired. They're confused as to what makes a latte and what makes a cappuccino. I ordered one once and none since. 

But what can I say. I'll take the bad scones and indifferent coffee drinks for the genuine friendliness of the place and my face is as green as their mugs when I think about how spoiled that neighborhood is while my part of town is totally bereft of coffeehouse awesomeness.

Oh, cash only though there's an expensive ATM on the premises.

evidence.text:
友好热情的氛氛围、员工和老板，加上非常合理的价格，使这里成为我最喜欢的社区咖啡馆。唯一能让它更好的是有本地面包师提供无麸质烘焙食品出售。

咖啡很好。非常好。他们卖La Colombe咖啡，而且知道怎么制作。他们还有十多种不错的茶选择，少量但精心挑选的烘焙食品、带奶油芝士和熏鲑鱼或其他配料的百吉饼，偶尔还有新鲜水果如香蕉出售，虽然绝对不是一顿完整的午餐。我听说百吉饼很棒。他们已经解决了饮品菜单的问题（另一条评论中提到散乱不清），墙上有一个清晰的横幅，我发现如果你问，他们总能想办法做出来。

有一个小的户外座位区，配有金属框架沙发和柔软干净的靠垫。非常适合春天和夏天，也是在这里社区结交新朋友的好地方。

前厅是一个放松的区域，可以工作、见人、和老板聊天（她在的时候），听她讲述她旅行丰富的生活故事。虽然她有时在工作时安静而不张扬，所以你可能需要主动提问才能让她开口。

员工也类似：安静、礼貌、高效、友好。问个问题，开始对话，他们就有丰富的生活经历可以分享。事实上，我在这里搭过话的大多数人都很有趣、有创意、鼓舞人心。也许是社区的原因，也许是咖啡因的作用，这里有些特别的东西。不装腔作势，从没见过男士发髻，人们真的会微笑。这很好。

后面有一个房间，有棋盘游戏、一张柔软干净的沙发和两把舒适的椅子，布置得像客厅/会客室，还有一张餐桌和椅子，非常适合学习小组和商务会议。

再加点俗气的话……作为摩羯座，我是发现这颗宝石的幸运山羊！;)
evidence.originalText:
The friendly and welcoming vibe, staff, and owner, combined with their very reasonable prices make this my favorite neighborhood coffeeshop. The only thing that would make it better would be having a local baker providing gluten free baked goods for sale here. 

Coffee is good. Very good. They carry La Colombe. And they know how to make it. They have 10 or more nice tea selections as well, a small but cared for selection of baked goods, bagals with cream cheese and lox or other toppings, and occasionally fresh fruit like a banana for sale, though it's not a full spread lunch spot by any means. I hear the bagels are fantastic.  They have remedied their drink menu issue (mentioned in another review as scattered and unclear) with a clear banner on the wall, and I find if you ask they can find a way to make it. 

There is a small outside sitting area with outdoor metal frame couches with soft clean cushions. Perfect for spring and summer days, and great spot to make new friends here in the neighborhood. 

The front room is a chill zone to work, meet people, chat with the owner when she's here, and listen to her stories of her well traveled life. Though she's sometimes quiet and unassuming while working here so you may have to be the one asking the questions to get her going.  

The staff are similar; quiet, polite, efficient, and friendly. Ask a question, start a conversation, and they're full of great life experiences to share. In fact, most of the people I've ever struck up a conversation with here have been interesting, creative, and inspiring. Maybe it's the neighborhood, maybe it's partly the caffeine, there is something special here. Un pretentious, haven't seen a man-bun ever here, and people actually smile here. That's nice.

There is a back room with board games, a soft clean sofa and 2 comfy chairs set up like a living room/sitting parlour, and a dining table and chairs, great for study groups and business meetings. 

And to add a bit of cheese...as a Capricorn, I am the Lucky Goat for finding this gem! ;)
